entry.title: Align Content — position layer content in one click
entry.content: I got tired of nudging things with the arrow keys to center them, so I wrote this. Pick a horizontal position (Left, Center, Right) and a vertical one (Top, Middle, Bottom), click OK. It finds the visible content on the current layer and moves it. "Leave as is" holds one axis still if you only want to center on the other. With no selection it positions against the canvas; with a selection it positions against the selection. Built with CodeLab using the modern Bitmap pipeline, so it needs Paint.N

entry.content: ComfyUI for Paint.NET Version 1.2.3 In short ComfyUI is a bridge between Paint.NET and a ComfyUI server.
